item.title: Re: Downvoted
item.content:encoded:
He's got just cause, to be honest.

One point I do disagree with, though, is that officers stopped making a career out of getting their men killed after WWI/WWII. There will always be someone that doesn't know what they are doing that will be concerned with their rank/awards/etc. or shouldn't be in command (often at the BEGINNING of conflicts) that don't think of them as men put as pieces on a board. They generally don't last long, just far too long.

The book that Dr Amaeus mentioned looked decent, but the usual "sanitized for public consumption" stuff. I was going to suggest Fiction and Fact from Dunc's Almanac, Green Side Out Brown Side out Run in circles Scream and Shout but they're out of print. They give a better understanding of the mentality.
Thanks, and sorry for hijacking your SCP's discussion thread.

item.title: Re: Downvoted
item.content:encoded:
An MTF guide might be nice, but I'd caution against it necessarily assuming all MTFs operate like US Marines or SWAT teams. There are plenty of articles where they're treated as men-in-black-suits, rather than commandos.

Also, while civilians may not know by experience what combat is like, it is possible for civilians to understand how military operations work; how military personnel conduct themselves towards their subordinates, equals, and superiors; what tactics are; how logistics are handled; how the psychological factors of combat affect individuals. These are all knowable and learnable without first hand experience (though first hand experience will often teach these lessons faster and more thoroughly).

item.title: Downvoted
item.content:encoded:
For the sole purpose of the MTF commander's first words in the tale. Here is a not-too-often-seen chance to show how someone on the bleeding edge would react to something. Someone brought up the issue that he knows the O5 is listening. But do this. Pretend you're the MTF commander for a moment.

You lead this team of men, and have for years. You know each one of their faces, their quirks, their foibles, how they'll react, what their old jobs were, where they're from. Family. And now another one of these scrawny-ass, lab-coat-wearing, rat-fucked little bastards is standing in front of you telling you to pick one. Pick one to send out to perform a task you know is doomed to failure, something that you know is gonna end in his death, and likely others, and something that you know is make things worse. Worse than that? You know goddamn well that they could have some smooth-talking D-Class do it. Hell, get a legit former cop. Someone that went dirty. They don't need your boys, but they're gonna do it anyway, because those fucking retards don't know what it's like. They never leave their damn offices and labs. The closest they ever get is hearing the shit on a radio, watching helmet cams, and listening to the mission logs recorded side by side. Bunch of cocksuckers come into your office and ask for your men?

What's your response gonna be? A dull, muted, trite, stock, cliche phrase that oh-so-cleverly includes "expunged" and "redacted"? No. You're gonna tell that bastard what you really think. He's gonna wonder what half the curse words and turns of phrase you used even mean. He'll know that you despise him, and have nothing but contempt for his shallow, cloistered, cowardly ways, asking for things he can't do himself. It doesn't matter if God himself is listening.
